# Mainframe metric refinements

Metric refinements extend upstream OpenTelemetry metrics with additional
entity associations and attributes specific to the
Mainframe domain.

| Upstream Metric | Refinement ID | Entity Associations | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `system.network.errors` | `refinement.mainframe.nic.system.network.errors` | mainframe.partition.nic | Count of network errors detected on the partition virtual NIC. |
| `system.network.io` | `refinement.mainframe.nic.system.network.io` | mainframe.partition.nic | Network bytes transmitted and received through the partition virtual NIC. |
| `system.network.packet.count` | `refinement.mainframe.nic.system.network.packet.count` | mainframe.partition.nic | Network packets transferred through the partition virtual NIC. |
| `system.network.packet.dropped` | `refinement.mainframe.nic.system.network.packet.dropped` | mainframe.partition.nic | Network packets dropped on the partition virtual NIC. |
| `system.network.errors` | `refinement.mainframe.port.system.network.errors` | mainframe.adapter.port | Count of network errors detected on the mainframe physical adapter port. |
| `system.network.io` | `refinement.mainframe.port.system.network.io` | mainframe.adapter.port | Network bytes transmitted and received through the mainframe physical adapter port. |
| `system.network.packet.count` | `refinement.mainframe.port.system.network.packet.count` | mainframe.adapter.port | Network packets transferred through the mainframe physical adapter port. |
| `system.network.packet.dropped` | `refinement.mainframe.port.system.network.packet.dropped` | mainframe.adapter.port | Network packets dropped on the mainframe physical adapter port. |
| `system.cpu.utilization` | `refinement.mainframe.system.cpu.utilization` | virtualization.platform, virtualization.partition | Per-logical-CPU utilization by mode, extended for IBM Z processor specialization. |


## `refinement.mainframe.nic.system.network.errors`

Refines upstream metric: `system.network.errors`

| Name | Instrument Type | Unit (UCUM) | Description | Stability | Entity Associations |
| -------- | --------------- | ----------- | -------------- | --------- | ------ |
| `system.network.errors` | Counter | `{error}` | Count of network errors detected on the partition virtual NIC. [1] | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `mainframe.partition.nic` |

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**[1]:** Measured as:

- Linux: the `errs` column in `/proc/net/dev` ([source](https://web.archive.org/web/20180321091318/http://www.onlamp.com/pub/a/linux/2000/11/16/LinuxAdmin.html)).
- Windows: [`InErrors`/`OutErrors`](https://docs.microsoft.com/windows/win32/api/netioapi/ns-netioapi-mib_if_row2)
  from [`GetIfEntry2`](https://docs.microsoft.com/windows/win32/api/netioapi/nf-netioapi-getifentry2).

**Attributes:**

| Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mainframe.partition.nic.name` | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | The name of the virtual network interface card (NIC) attached to a logical partition (LPAR) in Dynamic Partition Manager (DPM) mode. [1] | `nic-0`; `nic-mgmt`; `nic-prod` |
| `network.io.direction` | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) | `Required` | string | The direction of traffic from the perspective of the observing host's physical or virtual network interface. It should not be used to represent the logical direction of a stateful connection or network flow. | `transmit` |
| `network.interface.name` | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) | `Recommended` | string | The network interface name. | `lo`; `eth0` |

**[1] `mainframe.partition.nic.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API partition-attached-network-interface metric group. In distributed systems terms, this is analogous to a virtual NIC (vNIC) attached to a virtual machine.

---

`network.io.direction` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `receive` | receive | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) |
| `transmit` | transmit | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) |

## `refinement.mainframe.system.cpu.utilization`

Refines upstream metric: `system.cpu.utilization`

| Name | Instrument Type | Unit (UCUM) | Description | Stability | Entity Associations |
| -------- | --------------- | ----------- | -------------- | --------- | ------ |
| `system.cpu.utilization` | Gauge | `1` | Per-logical-CPU utilization by mode, extended for IBM Z processor specialization. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `virtualization.platform`; `virtualization.partition` |

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**Attributes:**

| Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mainframe.cpu.type` | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | The type of mainframe processor within the Central Processing Complex (CPC). [10] | `all`; `cp`; `icf` |
| `cpu.mode` | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) | `Recommended` | string | The mode of the CPU [11] | `user`; `system` |
| `cpu.logical_number` | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Opt-In` | int | The logical CPU number [0..n-1] | `1` |
| `mainframe.cpu.sharing.mode` | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Opt-In` | string | The sharing mode of the mainframe processor — whether it is dedicated to one partition or shared across multiple partitions. [12] | `all`; `dedicated`; `shared` |

**[10] `mainframe.cpu.type`:** IBM Z processor specialisation type (cp, ifl, iip, icf, sap, cbp, aap). Maps to HMC CPC and logical partition usage fields.

**[11] `cpu.mode`:** Following modes SHOULD be used: `user`, `system`, `nice`, `idle`, `iowait`, `interrupt`, `steal`

**[12] `mainframe.cpu.sharing.mode`:** Indicates whether the utilization measurement represents shared or dedicated processors.

---

`cpu.mode` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | Idle | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) |
| `interrupt` | Interrupt | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) |
| `iowait` | IO Wait | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) |
| `nice` | Nice | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) |
| `steal` | Steal | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) |
| `system` | System | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) |
| `user` | User | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) |

---

`mainframe.cpu.sharing.mode` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `all` | All mainframe processors, both shared and dedicated. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `dedicated` | The processor is dedicated to a specific partition and cannot be shared with other partitions. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `shared` | The processor can be shared among multiple partitions and is not dedicated to a specific partition. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |

---

`mainframe.cpu.type` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aap` | Application Assist Processor (AAP), a processor dedicated to accelerating Java and XML processing for database workloads. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `all` | All types of mainframe processors combined. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `cbp` | Coupling Bus Processor (CBP), a processor dedicated to high-speed coupling facility (CF) bus communication between systems in a sysplex. Present only in HMC versions 2.14.0 through 2.15.0. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `cp` | Central Processor (CP), the general-purpose processor that hosts a mainframe operating system such as z/OS. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `icf` | Integrated Coupling Facility (ICF), a processor dedicated to running coupling facility workloads for high-speed communication between systems in a sysplex. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `ifl` | Integrated Facility for Linux (IFL), a processor dedicated to running Linux workloads on the mainframe. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `iip` | z Integrated Information Processor (zIIP), a processor dedicated to offloading eligible workloads such as Java applications from general-purpose processors. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `sap` | System Assist Processor (SAP), a processor dedicated to system management and I/O processing workloads. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
